messages:
maya: Kicking off slow roll for v2.3.1 in US slice at 23:00 PT. reserving 120 pGPU units.
jamal: Confirmed reserved capacity on dedicated pool us-east-1: 120 GPUs, burst 30.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @maya at 2026-03-21T23:00Z. Canary 2% -> 10% -> 25% over 30m windows.
rachel: Will smoke-test critical endpoints after canary. Tests: /generate, /embeddings, /batch.
liam: Can someone sanity-check EU capacity? We want mirrored 80 GPUs and 20 burst.
suzanne: EU quota available: 100 GPUs, thermal headroom ~15%. We'll pin model to v2.3.1-quant for EU to save memory.
maya: Pin matrix: US=v2.3.1-quant, EU=v2.3.1-quant, APAC=v2.2.9-quant (fallback). Rollback policy: auto rollback on 5xx rate >2% OR latency p95 >1.2s sustained for 10m.
jamal: Adding operational budget check: if token-cost estimate > $1,500/minute -> pause promotion.
ops-bot: Preflight smoke results: KV cache warmup 92% after 10m, batching latency improved 18%.
deploy-bot: Canary promoted to 10% in US at 6150001260 by @deploy-bot.
rachel: Smoke: /generate ok, /tool-call flaky (timeout 504) — tagging @eng-runtime for immediate look.
liam: Noted. Thermal telemetry shows one host in us-west hitting 92% GPU temp; throttling policy engaged.
suzanne: Spinning up 10 extra warm pool instances in us-west:
```
infra scale --pool us-west-warm --add 10 --type p4d
```
maya: Manual hold: pausing further promotions until 6150001290. Notifying CS and SRE.
jamal: If issues persist at hold expiry, plan = immediate pinback to v2.2.9 across affected regions and cancel queued promotions.
rachel: After fix, re-run minimal regression suite: /tests/regr/smoke-gen and /tests/regr/embeds.
ops-bot: Alert: latency p95 US rose to 1.35s at 6150001275 — exceeds the 1.2s threshold.
deploy-bot: Promotion halted by @maya at 6150001278. Canary slices scaled back to 2%.
maya: Executing pinback for US to v2.2.9-quant now. ETA ~6m.
liam: Confirmed pinback success on us-west and us-east. No customer-facing errors seen post-pin.
suzanne: APAC hold: keep APAC on v2.2.9 for now; will replay buffered queue once US is stable.
maya: Summary: US roll -> thermal + tool-call flake -> hold -> pinback -> stable. Next steps: postmortem + release-notes update in eng-releases tomorrow 11:00 PT. I'll draft the rollback rationale.
jamal: I'll update the release ticket with capacity numbers, thermal telemetry, and cost delta. :thumbsup:
rachel: Thanks — follow-up assigned to eng-runtime to investigate tool-call timeouts.
maya: Closing thread. Will post an updated prod timeline and public release-note blurb in #release-notes when done. :white_check_mark:
